text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Haaaaaaahhhhh!!” 
“Haaaaahhh!!”

Joy welled up from deep within my chest. 
Even against 
Seiun Sky, a peer from the Classic Triple 
Crown route, 
she was proving her true caliber beyond 
doubt.
And as proof of that—
(Waaaaahhh!)

—The moment of the finish. Deafening 
cheers engulfed Sapporo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... 
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(This is... this frenzy. 
The very thing I once envied—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Phalaenopsis!! 
What a run! You completely captivated me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky was amazing, too! 
That was thrilling! What a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(There is not the slightest need for 
modesty. 
This heat... exists because I ran.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(By locking horns, Sky and I set the 
stands ablaze 
with fiery passion. We created this 
frenzy.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see, ... 
I have become an Umamusume of such 
caliber—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there~ Man... I mean, 
that was surprisingly fun, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because you were truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I was underestimating you 
at all. 
I thought I understood just how strong you 
were, 
Phalaeno-chan. That's why I prepared, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Even so... it gave me total chills.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, is that so? Then my swift feet 
were worthy of making you run in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My thanks, Sky. Crossing swords with you 
has shown me anew—where I stand today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Meaning—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I can hold my own against you all as you 
are now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Let us depart, as planned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To where the reigning queen sits 
enthroned— 
To the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That queen is... beautiful, and strong. 
A formidable foe, embodying the Tiara 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is a foolish question, but... 
heh. 
As my Trainer, are you certain you 
shouldn't stop me?

She has delivered results on the Tiara 
route. 
She proved her caliber against Seiun Sky— 
There is no longer any reason to doubt her 
strength.
choice_data_list: You can become the queen of the next era.

You have what it takes to be the next 
queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Haha. 
If you are so certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Then so shall I become.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we go to claim it? 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: A future in full, magnificent bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Phalaenopsis. She'll surely 
be at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Still, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Defeating a girl like her 
—that's what makes a true queen.

The Queen Elizabeth II Cup— 
There, two flowers shall bloom. 
Yet, there is only one throne.
